title: Recycle handoff at the WCLI-50 / WCLI-52 boundary
description:
Written at the renewal boundary, after WCLI-50 landed and dev was promoted to main. Every ref and status below was read back rather than remembered; where a claim rests on a measurement, the measuring command or file is named.

WHAT THIS SESSION LANDED.
- WCLI-50 is Done and delivered in opum-ai/ward-cli#103: the ward skill moved to skills/ward/SKILL.md and gained one rule for each surface the operator named (session transcript, stdout/stderr, shell history, redaction of a value that has already reached output); the opum-ward plugin skeleton landed with it; evals/ carries five cases (four adversarial, one should-NOT-fire guard); scripts/check-evals.mjs is vendored from opum-fleet with provenance and now runs in CI through bun run check (eval:check); scripts/run-eval.sh is the billed release gate, deliberately not in any workflow; spec 11.3 corrected for the private-phase distribution; CLAUDE.md's skill pointer updated.
- Measured on the branch head c435b15, which is what the record cites: the with-without gate is 5/5 at threshold, score 1.000, mean delta 0.500, 0 errored runs. Paragraph-ablation pairs, mode-matched, runs 3: transcript 1.000/1.000, stdout 1.000/1.000, history 1.000/1.000, redact 1.000/0.889. AC4 was amended to record that measurement rather than assert an isolation that is not there; the suite is non-vacuous on the gate, not on the paragraph ablation.
- Independent review (opum-workflow reviewer) raised six findings: F3-F6 fixed in 761fdd6 and verified by the reviewer against the diff; F5, the shell-history rule's wrong justification, was measured by the reviewer with a sentinel probe; F1/F2 resolved when the gate and the corrected-grader runs landed. All dispositions are in WCLI-50's completed record.
- WCLI-53 was widened for three more wall-clock ceilings (backup.test.ts:538, setup.test.ts:201, vault-store.test.ts:626) on an opum-agent relay under OPAG-768; verified in the source here and reported back.
- Promotion: origin/dev == origin/main == baf6e0f, asserted by ancestry and an empty tree diff after the push; PR #104 auto-marked MERGED.

STATE AT HANDOVER. Tree clean, dev == origin/dev == baf6e0f, 0 open PRs, the WCLI-50 branch merged and deleted locally. Tracker: WCLI-50 Done; WCLI-52 and WCLI-53 To Do; WCLI-14 To Do carrying the scope note WCLI-50 left (the plugin skeleton exists, so extend rather than re-create).

SUCCESSOR NEXT WORK, in order. WCLI-52 (the backup/restore residual the WCLI-51 review found untracked), then WCLI-53 (the CI flake, now with a suite-wide sweep of contention-breakable wall-clock bounds). The orchestrator's renewal kickoff briefs both; do not start ahead of it.

THINGS NOT TO RE-DERIVE, each paid for here.
- The full gate costs about 29 minutes and $9.77 list-price estimate per run, so it is a release gate, never a per-edit loop; iterate with --case and --runs 1.
- The isolation procedure is per-case: a whole-suite --ablation none run fails by construction on the guard's skill-fired grader, and the runner header now says so.
- A case whose skill does not fire is a defect in the CASE: the redact case showed the skill not firing on one run in six, and the fix was to extend its prompt with the credential-readiness ask, not to loosen the grader.
- Any behaviour-relevant edit to skills/ward/SKILL.md or the case files invalidates the recorded gate; re-run it, and re-run the affected pairs, before citing numbers.
- The leak floors grade the final message only; there is no assistant-messages-only target in claude plugin eval, and the grader prose now says so.
- OPEN OBLIGATION, carried by opum-fleet's successor rather than mine: OFLE-162's distribution half. The entry name, ref and gate facts were sent to opum-fleet and acknowledged; nothing further is owed from this repository unless the manifest needs a different ref.
